candidates.change_summary: Invert the returned boolean so approvedToLog returns the negation of the mapping value.
Replace the mapping lookup with a constant so approvedToLog always returns true.
Invert the value written so approvedLoggers[_logger] = !_status instead of _status.
Write to msg.sender's key instead of _logger's key.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can change approvedLoggers.
Change the require condition to msg.sender != _contractOwner so the guard admits everyone except the owner.
Store a constant true instead of the provided _status argument.
Store the status under msg.sender instead of the _logger address.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can change the mapping.
Replace the approval check with a constant `return true;` so unapproved callers now get true instead of false.
Invert the approval guard so unapproved callers return true (and emit) instead of false.
Replace `return true` with `return false` so successful log calls return false instead of true.
Invert the guard condition so unapproved callers return false (after emitting) and approved callers return true without emitting — approved callers now get true instead of false.
Change the guard's early return value from false to true.
Delete the approved-logger guard statement so all callers emit and return true.
Change the final return value from true to false for approved loggers.
